name: Cassius Rhodes
source:
Species: Object Head

Cassius is a timid little keyboard, due to being treated as an object by humans and other duenkhy alike. He's an aspiring musician, but his own feelings of insufficiency interfere with these aspirations quite often. A bit of a daydreamer. He plays demo songs against his will when he feels strong emotions.

"Please don't play my face!"

[From [url=http://www.duenkhy.com/]official site[/url]]
